discovery.map_measures: Frequency of the C allele at the traditionally named IL6 −174 promoter variant.
discovery.relevance: IL-6 participates in inflammation and B-cell maturation. Reported genotype–phenotype associations vary by context and ancestry, so this map should be read as population variation rather than an inflammatory or clinical marker.

discovery_groups.biology: Hemoglobin carries oxygen, while the G6PD enzyme protects red blood cells from oxidative damage. Variation in either system can affect red-cell survival and has been shaped partly by malaria-related selection.
discovery_groups.label: Red blood cell disorders
discovery_groups.summary: Hemoglobin and red-cell enzyme traits tied to oxygen transport and cell survival.

discovery_groups.biology: IL-10, IL-6, and TNF are immune signaling proteins. IL-10 has major immunoregulatory effects, while IL-6 and TNF have prominent roles in inflammatory responses.
discovery_groups.label: Cytokine regulation
discovery_groups.summary: Regulatory variants in signaling proteins that coordinate immune responses.

discovery_groups.biology: HLA-A, HLA-B, and HLA-C molecules display mostly intracellularly derived peptides to CD8 T cells and can also interact with KIR receptors on natural killer cells. Different alleles bind different peptide repertoires.
discovery_groups.label: HLA class I
discovery_groups.summary: HLA-A, HLA-B, and HLA-C alleles involved in intracellular antigen display.

discovery_groups.biology: HLA-DP, HLA-DQ, and HLA-DR molecules display mostly extracellularly derived peptides to CD4 T cells. Their high diversity affects immune recognition and histocompatibility.
discovery_groups.label: HLA class II
discovery_groups.summary: HLA-DP, HLA-DQ, and HLA-DR alleles involved in extracellular antigen display.

discovery_groups.biology: KIR receptors on natural killer cells interpret HLA class I signals. In a KIR name, 2D or 3D denotes two or three extracellular domains; L denotes a long, usually inhibitory tail, while S denotes a short, activating architecture.
discovery_groups.label: Natural killer-cell receptors

references.label: NCBI Bookshelf — The KIR gene cluster

discovery_groups.summary: KIR genes that tune natural-killer-cell activation through HLA signals.
